decisions.decision: Move the overnight queue to the contractor team starting next month
decisions.source_quote: So, we are moving the overnight queue to the contractor team, starting next month. That is settled, no more discussion on that.
About phone support, some people think we need it and some people think it costs too much. We did not decide anything. We will look again after the customer survey comes back.

action_items.source_quote: Tomás will update the escalation guide before the end of the week.
Everyone should read the new refund policy before Monday.
